entities.name: PMID:27502292
observations: Prospective cohort of 1,469 low-to-intermediate-risk patients followed for mean 7.8 years; 41 MACE events occurred.
LAP <60 HU and napkin-ring sign had the largest reported MACE associations in this cohort: HR 4.96 and 3.85, respectively.
Spotty calcification, stenosis severity, and plaque type had smaller reported associations than LAP <60 HU and napkin-ring sign.
Negative coronary CTA was associated with 0% MACE in this cohort.

entities.name: LAP and NRS prognostic ranking
observations: Within the Kristensen et al. cohort, LAP <60 HU and napkin-ring sign were the strongest individual evaluated CTA predictors of MACE after comparison with stenosis, plaque type, and spotty calcification.

The ranking is cohort- and model-specific; a broader meta-analysis found napkin-ring sign stronger than low-attenuation plaque overall, and combined high-risk plaque features had the greatest pooled risk.
